description: Echo protected paths — absolute read-only for UI automation. Any modification triggers immediate STOPPED.

phase3f.note: Phase 3F scoped authority (docs/05-planning/phase3f-execution-plan.md §1.1, §4.6): after 3F.0 is human-merged, a protected path becomes editable for a specific 3F task ONLY when that task's exhaustive Files list names it. Every protected path outside that per-task scope keeps severity 'stopped' unchanged, with the same immediate STOPPED and no-retry-budget behavior.

protected_categories.description: Core domain logic and public semantics
Data models, database schema, migrations, persistence rules
Privacy declarations, signatures, entitlements, release configs, secrets
CI security gates, SwiftLint baseline, acceptance policy
Live Simulator review rules and acceptance policy
Model files, model download/packaging logic, ProximaKit integration boundaries

phase3f_scoped_authority.enabled_when: 3F.0 docs-only bootstrap PR is human-merged into dev-1.0; no scoped authority exists before that merge
phase3f_scoped_authority.authority_source: docs/05-planning/phase3f-execution-plan.md §1.1 (post-merge standing authority) and §4.6 (per-task exhaustive Files contracts)

editable_scope.condition_a_task_files: A specific 3F task's exhaustive Files list (the Files block of that task's execution-plan section, mirrored by its §4.6 doc contract) must name the exact path
editable_scope.condition_b_3f0_merged: 3F.0 is human-merged; edits under this authority may not proceed before that merge
editable_scope.no_overwrite: Existing human-approved work, worktrees and branches are never overwritten or deleted (no-overwrite/no-reset/no-clean/no-delete rules of §6.2.1 still apply)
editable_scope.no_expansion: Fuzzy paths, generalized descriptions or unmarked wildcards may not widen a task's scope; if RED tests prove a previously unlisted file must change, the task becomes blocked and only a human-approved scope PR amending the canonical plan, named ADR and task ledger may add it

protected_outside_scope.rule: Every path not named in the current 3F task's exhaustive Files list retains its original protected_categories severity ('stopped'), this file's stop_rule and the no-retry-budget behavior
human_only_operations: any action outside the current task's explicit scope

preserved_rules: immediate STOPPED on any write to a protected path outside the authorized per-task scope
no retry budget consumed for protected-path violations
no screenshot/video/reference/actual/diff generation or persistence (media-policy.json global_prohibition)
dual-device Live Simulator Review + AX tree + unified logs + structured manifest only; visualMediaCaptured: false
retry ceilings and stop conditions unchanged (retry-policy.json)

allowed_categories.description: SwiftUI Views and pure presentation components
UI semantic tokens and component styles
UI contracts, UI-layer tests, artifact collection config

stop_rule: Any write to protected paths triggers immediate STOPPED. No retry budget consumed. phase3f_scoped_authority is the ONLY mechanism that can make a protected path editable; unless BOTH conditions hold (3F.0 human-merged AND the exact path is in the current 3F task's exhaustive Files list), this rule applies unchanged with severity 'stopped'.
